description: Runtime evidence for coding agents through MCP. Run .NET builds and tests, capture failures and traces, compare runs, and connect stack frames to C# symbols.
releaseNotes:
## [3.2.0] - 2026-11-18
Features:
- drop the failed-test MSBuild tail from runnerOutput and count it per stream
- show the failing test's source lines in trace_run_tests
- accept exact test names with dotnet-test and name policy executables
- run the glider-trace tool on .NET 11 when .NET 10 is absent
Bug Fixes:
- redact the test name in failure source excerpts
- bind a base call in failure sources to the base type, not the override
